title: Netflix's Magic: The Gathering series is called Planeswalker and arrives in 2027
summary: The animated show, first announced in 2019, finally has a title, a first image and a release year.
body:
Netflix has revealed that its long-awaited animated series based on the card game Magic: The Gathering will be called Planeswalker and will be released in 2027.

The streaming service shared a first image and a short behind-the-scenes video this week, timed to the MagicCon fan event in Atlanta.

The story and the team

The series centres on Chandra, a fire mage who is hunted for her powers. It is led by Terry Matalas, who was showrunner on the third season of Star Trek: Picard, with Cindy Appel as co-showrunner.

Netflix first announced the project in 2019 with a different creative team, who left in 2021. It is made with Hasbro Entertainment and Wizards of the Coast, the company behind the game.

Sources: Netflix, UPI, Animation World Network.
